newsitem.title: USA: NutraMax to acquire first aid business.
newsitem.headline: NutraMax to acquire first aid business.

text.p: NutraMax Products Inc said on Monday it has agreed to buy the first aid business of American White Cross Inc, which is presently in bankruptcy, for $40 million and the assumption of certain liabilities.
American White Cross is a leading manufacturer and marketer of store brand and value brand first aid products.
The purchase price is subject to adjustment based upon the value of inventory, accounts receivable, and the amount of assumed liabilities as of the closing date, NutraMax said in a statement.

At the closing, approximately $5,000,000 will be deposited in escrow to secure primarily the post-closing purchase price adjustments and indemnity obligations of American White Cross, the company said.
The deal is subject to U.S. Bankruptcy Court approval, completion of due diligence and procurement of financing, NutraMax said.
